name: Improved Firespray
body:
Your firespray is particularly potent.

Prerequisite(s): haan, firespray ability.

Benefit(s): You roll d8s for the damage of your firespray instead of d6s. If you normally add 1/2 your level to the damage, also increase the number of dice that you roll by 1.
